scope: Values the screens and the README carry, each with how far it was read on 6 November 2026, in about seven minutes of searching within the brief's 20-minute bound. Search summaries are second-hand; recalled values were not re-read in this study and stay open until checked. The follow-up of the same day added the eel dossier on domain/food-systems (commit cb85374c, on the remote only), read with git show, and the values it cites second-hand.

sources.citation: Fish Migration River Afsluitdijk, Layman's report (English), 1 May 2025
sources.use: Design requirements (no passage of salt water into the IJsselmeer; always open for fish except at extreme water levels or excessive salt, when valves close); a winding river several kilometres long following the Wadden Sea's tides; about EUR 80 million; around 250 million fish a year trying to migrate, 70% expected to pass
sources.read: Text extracted from the PDF; sections 2.1-2.3 and 10.2-10.4 read; no salt-leakage record found or read

sources.citation: Wageningen University & Research / Dutch delta fact sheet: Salt intrusion
sources.use: Measures at locks: air bubble screens (Terneuzen, Krammerjachten pilot), fresh-water flushing, the salt-fresh separation that pumps salt water from the chamber floor and fresh water in from the top
sources.read: Text extracted from the PDF and skimmed for the lock measures; no exchange rates or reduction percentages found in the passages read

sources.citation: Innovative Salt-Freshwater Separation System at the Krammer Locks, The Netherlands (Springer conference chapter, 2022)
sources.use: The boundary between salt and fresh water in the chamber lowered by withdrawing salt water through the floor while fresh water enters through the walls; bubble screens at both lockheads and a flushing discharge
sources.read: Search-engine summary; chapter not opened

sources.citation: USACE ETL 1110-2-347, Densimetric Froude number; Farmer & Armi (1986), Maximal two-layer exchange over a sill and through the combination of a sill and contraction with barotropic flow, J. Fluid Mech. 164
sources.use: No salt wedge forms where the fresh flow's densimetric Froude number exceeds 1 (values of 0.6-0.7 already prevent one in practice); a fresh Froude number above 1 expels the wedge from the channel
sources.read: Search-engine summaries; Farmer and Armi recalled, not re-read
